# Kioku 0.7.0
- Scribe is now Kioku. The app, its menu bar item, its recording pill, alerts, Settings, the installer and the update feed all use the new name, and the app icon is the new "K" mark. - Nothing you have set up changes. Your library, recording setup, students, memories, transcription runtime, paired Macs and macOS permissions carry over unchanged, because the app keeps the same bundle identifier and storage locations underneath. - Updates keep arriving through the same feed. If you installed an earlier version and updated in place, the file in Applications may still be called "Scribe.app" even though it is Kioku inside; rename it to "Kioku.app" whenever you like, or reinstall from the disk image, which is named Kioku-0.7.0.dmg. - Audio devices Kioku creates while recording now appear as "Kioku Private Capture" and "Kioku Remote / System Audio" in Audio MIDI Setup; the ones an earlier version created are still cleaned up.

# Scribe 0.6.9
- Speaker echo cancellation is always on. Every microphone capture now goes through Apple Voice Processing, with headphones or speakers, so the experimental "Speaker echo" switch in Settings → Recording is gone. Recordings made earlier keep their stored setting and still decode. - Settings → Recording and Settings → AI & Memory read shorter: the explanatory sentences under each row were removed, and the "Recording safeguards" group is now called "Calls". Login-item problems are still shown when they occur. - Student memories filed under "Learning grievances & suggestions" are now called "Worries & suggestions".

# Scribe 0.6.8
- There is now one recording setup. Settings → Recording edits exactly what New Recording uses; the Setup and Manage menus are gone, and any setups you had saved were merged into your default on first launch. The "My voice" switch is gone too: choose Full lesson or Students only on New Recording. - The folder for new recordings lives in Settings → Library, next to the library location. Lessons already saved elsewhere stay where they are and remain in History, where the "Setup" filter is now called "Source". - Lesson audio takes less space. Once a transcript is published, the original uncompressed tracks are replaced by compact AAC copies, and a scratch file left behind by transcription is removed. The sidebar shows the library's size. - Lesson analysis (briefs, reports, memory and weakness evidence) runs on a Russian-hosted model by default, so lesson text stays with a Russian provider. OpenAI is available only with your own key, entered under Settings → AI & Memory → Advanced, with an anonymised option that replaces names, places and dates before sending. - Call detection is steadier: a browser must hold the microphone and speaker for twenty seconds before it counts as a call, only one call is offered at a time, and an app you can see in the Dock is always treated as itself rather than the app that opened it.

# Scribe 0.6.7
- Fixed a transcription failure that could stop a lesson after the model produced a very long repeated syllable. - Transcription now keeps previous-text context within the model’s token limit and retries an affected section once with fresh context and protection against repeated syllables. - Normal speech repetitions and false starts are preserved. Original recordings remain unchanged.

# Scribe 0.6.6
- Scribe now notices any call, not only Zoom, Meet, Telemost and Teams. It reads the microphone and speaker flags macOS keeps for each app, so FaceTime, Discord, Skype, Telegram, WhatsApp and other apps or sites count once one app has used both for five seconds. No audio is captured to do this. - When a call starts, Scribe asks first. The floating pill shows "Discord call started · Record?" with Record, Not now and, for calls found by audio, Never for that app. Nothing records until you answer. Start automatically and Off remain as choices in Settings → Recording. - A microphone released for twenty seconds ends the meeting, so a Meet tab hidden behind another tab or a closed browser window no longer needs a manual Stop. - Open Scribe at login is a switch in Settings, off by default. Scribe only notices calls while it is open, so this keeps a lesson from being missed after a restart. - Firefox, Vivaldi, Chromium and Orion are now scanned for meeting pages. - The student list no longer has an Archive button at the bottom; archiving lives in the student's "…" menu, and the archive itself stays reachable from the Lessons list and Library settings. - The memory row menu opens reliably again, and moving the row no longer re-runs layout during navigation. The selected sidebar item is a muted accent wash instead of a bright pill.
